reviews.text: I've taken several dogs there for consultations, checkups, etc., and they've always been treated very well. Two days ago, I went in for an emergency, and the speed and efficiency with which they attended to us was impressive. Thank you so much, Nicanor and his family are very grateful. 🫶🏽 …

They provide a very personal touch and examine every detail, following up on treatment via WhatsApp in the following days. It's clear they don't want to overcharge you for caring for your pets. They keep a detailed record of each animal and explain the reasoning behind every treatment option. We take our two cats there and we're extremely happy with the care.
They operated on and cared for my kitten wonderfully, and they also gave me the correct medication and a perfect explanation of the post-surgery care...very professional! I recommend them 100% :)

I am very grateful for the kindness, personalized attention, and professionalism of the entire team. I especially want to highlight the veterinarian, Mireia. They not only care for pets with tenderness but also do everything possible to be mindful of people's budgets. 100% recommended. Thank you!

It's the best clinic, in my opinion. I moved far away and can no longer take my cats here, but I think every day that there are no vets anywhere like the ones at Dacs. Or at least I'm finding it hard to find one. I'll always remember Chiara's excellent care; she handled my cat's case with FIP and feline leukemia, and now she's perfectly healthy months later. I can't explain how well things are done here; you simply have to take your furry friends. The staff is very caring, there's a great atmosphere, and they genuinely care about the animals.

The girl at the reception is rude and she thinks you owe her something. You need to learn what customer service means first and then start working with people. People like you should not work with customers….you can’t just treat people like that.

My dog ​​got quite sick.
She had bouts of diarrhea.
You can't imagine the state of the clinic's waiting room.
With unparalleled kindness, without a single complaint, they meticulously cleaned everything.
They were exceptional.
Their service and professionalism impressed me.
My dog ​​is doing well now.

A very bad experience. I want to especially highlight the terrible service from the young woman who attended to us today around 10:45. From the very first moment, her attitude was despotic, arrogant, and highly unprofessional.

We expected to receive respectful and friendly treatment, especially when visiting a veterinary clinic with our pet, but the service we received left much to be desired. The way she spoke to us was completely inappropriate and made us feel very uncomfortable.

It's one thing to have a difficult day, but quite another to treat customers with that attitude. Customer service should be based on respect, empathy, and courtesy, and unfortunately, we found none of that today.

I hope the clinic takes this situation into account and seriously reviews the way customers are being treated. A very unpleasant experience, and I, for one, would not return.
Exceptional service and great professionals. I took my dog ​​in for tendinopathy with calcifications, and after several shockwave therapy sessions, she recovered. Javier is fantastic.

We found this veterinary clinic through the animal shelter where we adopted our three kittens, and what a discovery! We've been taking them there for 11 years (their whole lives). The way they treat the animals and their humans couldn't be more tender and professional, only performing tests when absolutely necessary according to their judgment and treating them with infinite patience. I want to thank Mireia, Chiara, Guille, and all of you for all these years (and for the many more to come)—you're wonderful!

Last week we took our newly adopted two-and-a-half-month-old kitten to the vet because he had a fever and other symptoms. I asked them several times to test him for viruses, but they refused. They simply performed a blood test, which showed high red blood cell count and anemia. They administered antibiotics and IV fluids, gave us some gastrointestinal food, and told us to "see how he progressed," so we left without a clear diagnosis.

We also informed them that he lived with another cat, so we needed to know the diagnosis as soon as possible to take the necessary steps and properly care for both animals.

Given the lack of answers and our great concern for his condition, we decided to go to another veterinarian to request the tests. There, he tested positive for feline panleukopenia.

I find it very difficult to understand why they refused to perform tests that we had specifically requested, especially since it was a kitten with a fever and clinical signs consistent with an infectious disease.

I don't have much more to add. Now we just hope our little one recovers soon.
Good service

Some receptionists are terrible, they have no idea what they're doing. I don't understand their screening process. I have two dogs and have had two serious problems. The first time, I called at 5:30 pm on a Tuesday because my 12-year-old dog, who I've had for a long time since I got him, was having diarrhea and vomiting. They told me to go to the 24-hour emergency clinic because they weren't seeing patients there (at 5:30 pm). I took him there, and he was diagnosed with acute pancreatitis and admitted. The second problem was a 4-year-old Chihuahua with recurring problems (he'd been like this for three weeks) with blood in his stool and hadn't eaten for 24 hours. I called on Friday at 9:30 am, and they told me that since it wasn't serious, they couldn't see him until Monday! I insisted, and they told me to bring him in, that they would admit him, and that they would visit him whenever I could! Is this really adequate care? Well, I'm sorry, but I'm not going to give a third chance. Gloria Romanos

Exceptional and professional treatment for your pets. I highly recommend them for any situation. In my case, it's to help Buffi, a French bulldog, regain mobility after surgery for a severe cervical herniated disc that resulted in total paralysis in all four limbs. Thanks to the attention, care, and techniques used, she is gradually recovering her mobility.
Thank you, Dacs!

I've been coming here for years and they always surpass themselves. Their attention and care for the animals is magnificent. Judith is a top-notch professional. She supported us with great sensitivity and compassion when we lost our cat. A highly recommended clinic.

I have been taking my cats to Dacs for years and have always received excellent treatment. They were the only ones who knew how to properly treat the epilepsy of one of my cats, and I will always be very grateful to them. Professional, friendly and with great respect for animals. Totally recommended.
Wonderful professionals! 🫶🏻♥️ …

The best veterinary clinic in Bcn, ask for Xavier, he is the best of all, with 30 years of experience, he saved my friend's two dogs and I am also delighted with him, look at the clinics I have visited in Balmes, nothing is impossible, thank you Xavier for existing

Javier is the best veterinarian in all of Barcelona. Not only is he incredibly dedicated to our pet, whose diagnosis has been quite complicated, but he's also incredibly empathetic and caring. We started with our Maltese's rehabilitation, and after previous experiences at other clinics that weren't as involved, we decided to return to them. I can't thank them enough for everything they've done since we arrived. Thank you, Javier, Guille, Tania, and the rest of the team.

The receptionist assistant was clueless. The veterinarians were incompetent and only interested in selling products. I had to take my dog ​​to another vet because here they were just trying to take my money without offering any solutions, only selling products without even knowing what was wrong with him.

The vets were very nice, but because of the disorganization of the curly-haired assistant who was at reception this morning, we won't be going back. She was giving us the runaround; our dog has been sick for days. Last week, she told us to come tomorrow whenever we wanted. We made arrangements to go, and when we got there, she told us no, we'd have to come in the afternoon. A week later, the same thing happened again. And she gives advice about vaccines without having a clue. Our puppy is 3 months old, and she wanted to schedule an appointment to give him his 4-month-old vaccine early, even though her own colleagues had told us that it's only effective after 4 months.

We took our puppy in twice because he had mucus in his stool, and at no point did they suggest a stool test. They kept saying it was normal in puppies, but we ended up having to get a stool test done elsewhere, which came back positive for two parasites, which were causing his condition. And the receptionist was trying to sell me probiotics, just to charge me more, because she didn't care about the dog.

Without a doubt, Javi is the best veterinarian you could find: highly professional, thorough, empathetic, and a true animal lover. He treats both the animal and the owner exceptionally well, providing clear and transparent explanations and always seeking the best solution. They have been caring for my dog ​​for her entire life (15 years), and even though I was living outside of Barcelona, ​​the trip was worthwhile to know that my dog ​​was in the best hands! If I adopt another animal, I will go back there without hesitation!
I couldn't be happier with Mireia's veterinary care for my cat and dog. Professional, attentive, honest, caring, and punctual. Thank you so much!

Eternally grateful to Clínica Dacs for their care and professionalism. Unfortunately, I can no longer continue Walter's rehabilitation, but both Javier and Tania treated him with great care, which is truly appreciated during difficult times.
Highly recommended!
We're very happy with the team. They treat Milo really well :)

I have a twelve-year-old cat. This clinic treats patients randomly, giving prescriptions without collecting urine. My cat has been there four times in emergencies. They even gave me a prescription for a cat with a different chip, named Tintin, without doing any tests or emptying his urethra. The cat was very stressed, not to mention the random medications they prescribe without palpating or collecting a urine sample. I don't recommend taking any cat to this place. Anyone who wants information can contact me privately.
I highly recommend this place. They've been coming to see my dogs for four years, and we're very happy with the service and attention. It's a bit pricey, but 100% effective.
Excellent professionals, honest and caring. I highly recommend them.

They are truly professional. I took my very old cat to them with a tooth problem, and I was very afraid of the anesthesia. They answered all my questions and performed the procedure incredibly professionally. I am always grateful to Javier and the other staff at Dacs Veterinari.
They're truly the best! They helped us so much! Super fast and cheap! Plus, they're so friendly! Thank you so much 💕💕💕 …
The truth is, they always treat me incredibly well, and they always answer any questions I have. Since I changed vets, Tom is definitely in very good hands 😍. I highly recommend them! …

This vet is fine for everyday things like vaccinations. It's not good for emergencies. I live next to this clinic, and a week ago my dog ​​had several seizures in a row. I called to have her stabilized, but they wouldn't see me and told me to go to the emergency room at another clinic. I had to drive 20 minutes to another vet with my dog ​​in my arms, almost unconscious.

Unfortunately, my dog ​​didn't make it. I'm not complaining about this situation, but if I get another dog in the future, I'll make sure to use their regular vet for emergencies to avoid this unpleasant experience.

I took a cat I was fostering, a kitten who had just given birth, and they said it was fine to spay her—a huge mistake. The kitten died of sepsis after five days and a long, agonizing death, despite our best efforts to save her. They butchered her.
They are very good with animals

Dacs, if Javier sees you, perfect, I highly recommend him, go without hesitation. If not, don't go. They charge you twice for the same tests, they charge you for visits without even seeing them, like they did to me, unbelievable. I have five cats, adopted from Gatos de Gracia, and I left because none of the other vets there are worthwhile. But I repeat, if Javier sees you, yes, but he sees them at the beginning and then delegates to the other vets; he focuses more on the recovery of dogs.

THE WORST EXPERIENCE I'VE EVER HAD.

I want to share my experience with DACS VETERINARY to warn other pet owners about the care I received. We took our cat in because of a bladder infection. Although he was initially treated and his bladder was emptied, the next day, after being sedated, his condition worsened drastically.

We returned on Monday as the cat was much worse. After some tests, we were told that the cat was very ill and that there was a chance he wouldn't survive. However, despite the serious results of his blood work and tests, they recommended we take him home and wait to see how he progressed. This was very disconcerting, especially when one of the veterinarians told us that the cat was very ill and could die.

Unfortunately, the situation worsened because the catheter wasn't properly positioned, and his bladder filled with urine again, contaminating his blood. Thanks to a recommendation from a friend at an animal shelter, we took our cat to another emergency veterinarian. There, we received a clear and honest diagnosis. We were informed that he needed to be admitted with IV fluids and appropriate medication, and that if we had waited two more hours, he could have died.

Fortunately, after 72 hours of treatment, our cat began to recover and was able to return home with normal blood pressure. If we hadn't sought a second opinion, I'm sure I wouldn't be here on my couch with my cat.

I cannot recommend this clinic based on such a bad experience. I won't even comment on the high prices, which I understand are part of veterinary care.

But the health and well-being of our pets are paramount, and they deserve proper and honest care.

I hope this review serves as a warning to other pet owners to take precautions.

Regarding the receptionist, I personally found her to be very kind and attentive.

The best vet in Barcelona. We took our dog here, and they cared for him exceptionally well in his final moments, with gentleness, empathy, and an impressive level of professionalism that we had never seen before in 13 years. It's such a shame we found them so late, but we're so glad our Fox passed away peacefully with such wonderful people by his side. Now we know that if we get another dog in the future, this will be their trusted vet. THANK YOU 🌟

My older dog could barely walk, and although it was hard for her at times, I could really feel the difference! I was about to consider putting her down because she could barely walk and she seemed to be in so much pain. It's expensive to have to go to the vet so many times, but it's so worth it. She's back to being a dog that runs and plays. I wish I had known months ago that I could take her there when I first noticed her mobility issues. I thought that because she was older, it was normal, which is true, but eventually my dog ​​started to suffer a lot from her joints. With the water and light therapy, I've noticed an incredible difference.
Simply fantastic, the check-ups are always perfect. Today we had a series of extractions on one of our cats, and everything was perfect!! Our trusted vets

I've been rescuing animals since 2016, and I've been to every vet in Barcelona, ​​including emergency hospitals. Without a doubt, DACS Veterinaris is one of the best veterinary clinics in the entire city, if not the best. The reception …

I'm very disappointed with the treatment I receive from the reception staff. I like the veterinarians, so I've overlooked the other issues the previous times I've been there. But I won't be going back after my last experience with a second …
My vet since my dog ​​was born. They are kind, attentive, and friendly. Every time I go, they treat my dog ​​like she's their own. They really make us feel like family. I recommend them 100%.
